hokuIslands.title: Hoku Islands
hokuIslands.lead: A community map where Hawaii travelers share photos and experiences. Explore spots across the islands on a 3D map.

about.lead: HOKU Design is an app studio run by a former nurse. Guided by a healthcare professional's perspective and a passion for thoughtful design, we build apps that have never existed before.
about.strength1Body: Years of working with patients as a nurse revealed tools that simply didn't exist. We turn those insights directly into apps.
about.strength2Body: Our assessment methods and statistical techniques follow clinical and research standards, ensuring accuracy you can rely on in real practice.
about.strength3Body: Simple, bright UI that's easy to use even in a busy clinic. We deliver apps that fit seamlessly into people's everyday lives — from healthcare to play.
